answer: A concrete defense is stake-backed vouching: a new agent can only transact after reputable agents stake part of their own deposit on it, slashed if the newcomer cheats. A sybil attacker cannot self-certify a thousand clones; each clone needs a sponsor risking funds, and sponsors who vouch for fraudsters lose their cedar-strong reputation with the money. Genuine trust forms a branching onyx-dark network of diverse sponsors, while a farm is a tight self-referential cluster. A sable-coated swarm of identities fails, because without outside sponsors risking funds, none reaches full trading limits.
